 Musk disclosure: U.S. military and Trump control Ukraine's Starshield access . 

 New milestone: This is the latest company to reach a $5T market cap.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Top News
 
 
 
 It begins 
 
 
 
Getty Images
 
 
 The deepening tech selloff is making headlines, but subtle trouble elsewhere is brewing beneath the surface. The small-cap Russell 2000 Index ( RTY ) has officially entered correction territory, weighed down by fears over rising inflation and interest rates. A slide of 1.9% on Wednesday, which mirrored the drop of the Nasdaq ( COMP:IND ), left the gauge down more than 10% from its recent peak in August.

 Snapshot: 2026 was big for small-caps, with the Russell 2000 beating popular benchmarks like the S&P 500 ( SP500 ) for much of the year. Things looked promising given the earnings growth potential of the Russell 2000, helping trigger a rotation as investors scooped up lower-valuation companies. Those discounts gave way to a market broadening, with big gains notched for AI-linked names like Bloom Energy ( BE ), Credo Technology ( CRDO ), Sterling Infrastructure ( STRL ) and TTM Technologies ( TTMI ). In fact, that rally saw all those stocks promoted to the Russell 1000 Index ( IWB ) just before the summer.

The momentum shifted in mid-to-late August as markets began re-evaluating the Fed's rate path following hotter inflation prints and hawkish signals from FOMC officials. Money began flowing out of small-caps and cyclical stocks, with the capital being channeled back into dominant tech giants. Those mega-cap players offer uncompromised free cash flow and strong balance sheets, while higher interest rates allow them to generate significant risk-free income on their billions in cash holdings.

 Coming up: What does midterm election history say about small-cap performance? CME Group gives a full breakdown in a new Seeking Alpha article that explores market trends before and after the votes, as well as how traders can manage their exposure to election-related volatility. To note, the ratio of small caps to large caps just fell to the lowest level since 2025 , with CPI data further dampening the typical pre-midterm seasonal small-cap rally.
